final_objective.what_system_does: Bob 24/7 living organism with reflection committee complete: multi-agent deliberation, post-trade review, and daily standup. Phase 3 delivered all reflection components. Ready for Phase 4 (Auto-Execution).
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 building autonomous Bob that reflects, learns, evolves.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Bob now has committee (4 agents vote), auto post-trade analysis, and daily standup reports with health score and plans.
final_objective.proof_output: committee.py deliberates with Cautious/Optimist/Analyst/Historian, post_trade_review.py analyzes closed trades, daily_standup.py generates daily reports.

what_was_done: Implemented committee.py: CommitteeRole enum (Cautious, Optimist, Analyst, Historian), CommitteeVote with approve/reject/abstain/conditional, CommitteeMember base class, 4 member implementations, ReflectionCommittee with deliberate(), get_vote_breakdown().

Implemented post_trade_review.py: TradeReview dataclass, PostTradeReviewer with review_trade(), review_batch(), extracts confidence, compares verdict vs outcome, generates lessons, determines severity.
Implemented daily_standup.py: DailyStandup dataclass, DailyStandupGenerator with generate(), render(), loads journal trades, calculates health score, creates tomorrow plans.
All three systems integrated with singleton pattern (get_reflection_committee(), get_post_trade_reviewer(), get_daily_standup()).

phase3_deliverables: committee.py: 4 agentes (Cautious, Optimist, Analyst, Historian), vote breakdown, approval threshold 75%, override 60%, render_for_bob() with committee reasoning
post_trade_review.py: analyzes verdict vs outcome match, generates what_went_right/wrong, creates lessons, severity levels (low/medium/high)
daily_standup.py: daily performance summary, XP progress, learning metrics, health score (0-100), tomorrow focus/goals, render() with full report
test_commands: python -c "from core.trading.committee import get_reflection_committee; c = get_reflection_committee(); d = c.deliberate({'ticker': 'AAPL', 'confidence': 0.75}); print(d.consensus.value)"

python -c "from core.trading.post_trade_review import get_post_trade_reviewer; r = get_post_trade_reviewer(); print(r.review_trade({'trade_id': 'test', 'ticker': 'AAPL', 'outcome': 'win', 'verdict_at_entry': 'Confidence 75%'}).severity)"
python -c "from core.trading.daily_standup import get_daily_standup; s = get_daily_standup(); print(s.generate().health_status)"

risks: Committee members use simplified heuristics (not full LLM agents)
Post-trade review requires journal to have verdict_at_entry field
Daily standup uses placeholder market_hours_active (6.5h fixed)
No integration yet between committee and actual trading decisions
Health score calculation needs validation with real data
next_step: Phase 4 (Auto-Execution): Implement auto_executor.py with gates (confidence, liquidity, risk, committee, kill switch), position_manager.py for open position management, and risk_guard.py for protection against excesses.
